text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "I did it! Woohoo!! I did it, finally!!"

She was simply in a different league here. 
Though she had zero composure, Tap Dance 
City still cruised to an easy victory—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, Tap Dance City, fresh off a 
thrilling victory, heads toward the 
winner's circle...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Head... to the winner's circle... Huh? 
They're not coming over.

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
Yes... It seemed she ran straight into the 
underground walkway, but...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone—!! We did it, we did it, we did 
it—!!"

text_block_list.name: 4 Companions
text_block_list.text: Tap!!

Crowded in together, arms slung over 
shoulders, vigorously shaking one another 
and laughing.

On this day, Tap Dance City won the thing 
she wanted most: "a future together with 
her friends." And then—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
An official contract... Signing a 
contract, huh...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
This is really bad... My hands won't stop 
shaking...

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired High School Girl
text_block_list.text:
Hang in there, Tap~ Here, wipe off your 
sweat~.

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Make sure not to write my name wrong, 
okay~? Like last time, writing 'Top Dance 
City'.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"M-My hand just slipped back then...! I 
won't mess up this time!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?
choice_data_list: Here. A fountain pen just for today.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Trainer, you went out of your way to...

I give a small nod, and hand her the pen 
I've kept ready all this time for this 
very day.

text_block_list.name: Real Estate Agent
text_block_list.text: Well then, your signature here, please.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Tap Dance City... noted.

text_block_list.name: Real Estate Agent
text_block_list.text:
Alright, that concludes our contract. I'll 
hand over the property by the end of the 
year.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: W-W-Woooaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Real Estate Agent
text_block_list.text:
Do your best! Lately, I just can't wait to 
see your achievements!

text_block_list.name: Real Estate Agent
text_block_list.text:
Being able to support them like this, and 
not just as a single fan, really is a 
wonderful thing.

text_block_list.name: Real Estate Agent
text_block_list.text:
And it makes me want to dream even bigger. 
I'll gladly lend you the land, so someday, 
take on the world...

text_block_list.name: Real Estate Agent
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, at the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe! 
Become the kind of Umamusume who shines on 
a massive stage like that.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe... Yes! Yes, 
I promise you!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I repay kindness with kindness! I'll never 
forget what I owe you, never!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Everyone... Everyone, with this, we're 
finally...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
No more rootless pirate crew for us!! 
Yeah!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: 4 Companions
text_block_list.text: Yay!!

And so, after completing all the 
paperwork—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks, Trainer. Thanks to you, my 
greatest goal was..."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
It looks like we'll secure our base of 
operations before the year is out. And 
that is all thanks to...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Those eyes of yours, fixed solely on your 
goal... It was precisely because we had 
that compass...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
In a sea full of distractions, you kept me 
from drifting away. Thanks for being here.
choice_data_list: No. The pleasure is mine, thank you.

text_block_list.text:
The gratitude is mutual. With this, an 
even greater dream unfolds. Yes—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Now, it's finally time to take on our real 
Challenge. Which means—
choice_data_list:
Yeah, our goal is to be the best in the 
world.

Yeah, our goal is to be the best in the 
world.

text_block_list.text:
Acquiring a base is merely the first step. 
Next, I must become the world's best and 
construct an unshakable, grand castle.

To aim for the top of the world, the very 
first thing we must do is...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, do you remember? Those promises 
we made back at the very beginning.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"To become number one in the world, an 
overseas campaign is a must! And before 
that—"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"A record breaker!! Running in a way that 
shatters domestic records."

To challenge the world, you naturally need 
world-class speed.

If we take on a race with a shocking 
record time and match that speed, it will 
serve as the ultimate proof.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
So, as for which race we should target 
next—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
In this country's racing history, which 
race is etched most intensely into 
everyone's memories?

Prompted by the question, I ponder. There 
are several record-breaking victories in 
Twinkle Series history that stand out.

However, among all those memories, the 
most vivid one has to be...

The memory of a certain GII race... 
Despite being a graded stakes, it was an 
unthinkable, wire-to-wire blowout victory.

That day when everyone witnessed a miracle 
on the turf... Yes, that race was—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"The 'Kinko Sho'... I see, that one, huh. 
The one where she pulled off a non-stop, 
one-sided game—"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —Silence Suzuka.
choice_data_list: Yeah, that's the race she won.
Yeah, that's the race she won.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka... Said to be faster than 
any express boat, she is the supersonic 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Whether or not I can run a race that 
surpasses that.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"That's good!! If I win and etch my name 
alongside those legends, my name will echo 
across the seven seas!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
All right, Trainer! Let's head out to 
those waters!

And so, the course was set, and a new flag 
was raised.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Next year's voyage sets sail with the 
Kinko Sho!
